verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents subscription management (multi-item, multi-frequency billing) and recurring invoices. However, nothing in the pack covers automatic retry of failed subscription payments, dunning logic, or recovery emails. The webhook retry and re-delivery evidence concerns event delivery to endpoints, not payment recovery, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails
